Trump's Houthi Stance Shifted After Saudi Arabia's Plea, Reports Say

Reports indicate that former US President Donald Trump was prepared to launch attacks against the Houthis following a request for assistance from Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS). However, Trump reportedly made a last-minute U-turn on this decision. Yemen had also asked the US for military support against the Houthis.
